question:
Select the most appropriate meaning for the given idiom.

Fall into line
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2) i.e. "Adhere to rules"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Fall into line": (अनुशासन में रहना) - To conform to a standard, rule, or demand.
 
• Example: Employees are expected to fall into line with the company's policies.
 
• Adhere to rules: (नियमों का पालन करना) - (To follow or comply with set rules or standards)
 
• Example: Students must adhere to rules while on campus.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Adhere to rules"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Searching something: (कुछ खोजना) - (To look for or seek something specific)
 
• Fuming and shouting: (गुस्से में चिल्लाना) - (To be very angry and vocal about it)
 
• Straight road to walk: (सीधी राह पर चलना) - (Literally, a direct or clear path to traverse; figuratively, a straightforward or uncomplicated situation)
